newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Promto plans bond, bonus, rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Promto plans bond, bonus, rights issue.

text.p: Malaysian manufacturing and property concern Promto has proposed a 60 million ringgit bond issue, a one-for-four bonus issue and a one-for-two rights issue at 4.50 ringgit per share.
A statement issued by the company's bankers on Thursday said the five-year 2.0 percent bank guaranteed bonds will be issued together with up to 20.57 million detachable warrants.
The bonus issue would involve up to 5.88 million new shares while up to 11.75 million new shares will be issued for the rights issue, it said.

Promto also plans to acquire 80 percent stake each in Nicograph Enterprise Sdn Bhd and Vistamina Sdn Bhd for a total 7.9 million ringgit to be satisfied by a cash payment of 4.74 million ringgit and an issue of 486,154 new Promto shares at 6.50 ringgit each. The two companies are involved in the manufacturing and dealing of paper products.
The statement said proceeds of the bonds and rights issue would be used to refinance bank borrowings, finance plant expansion and property development projects, and for working capital.
Promto's paid-up capital will increase to 62.19 million ringgit upon completion of the proposals.
Promto shares closed at 11.40 ringgit on Thursday.
